journey.name: paykit server approval while the node restarts
journey.description: Verifies that a Bitcoin watch-only Paykit Server setup approved while the Lightning node is stopped or being rebuilt completes on the first Authorize, and that the node tracks the new account once it starts. Precondition: an isolated wallet with a Pubky identity, on the integration fixture runtime described in the suite README, and a fresh setup auth URL with x-bitkit-claim=watch-only-account-v1 from the Shop's Connect Bitkit dialog or the Paykit Server setup fixture.

actions.action: Record the current wallet's watch-only account names and derivation paths
Send Bitkit to the background with the home button. The stop is debounced by 5 seconds and can take up to 30 seconds more; wait until the app log shows "Node stopped" from LightningService
Open the fixture setup auth URL in the wallet with adb
Without waiting for the wallet to finish syncing, tap Approve on the receiving-details introduction, then Authorize, and complete PIN or biometrics if asked
Verify the success screen appears and no "The wallet must be running before an account can be created" toast is shown
Verify the Shop dialog or the fixture reports the setup as complete
Wait for the wallet to finish syncing, then open the watch-only accounts list in Settings
Verify exactly one new account was added, named after the requesting service, with tracking on
